findings: Inspected overview review-001 and both target original/overlay sheets at all ten recorded frames, including exact midpoint frame 317. The dark-hoodie foreground actor remains selected through standing, kneeling to iron the floor, leaning forward and standing again. Head, torso, visible arm and folded-leg silhouette remain localized; both seated background people and the iron remain excluded. Self-occluded limbs are not treated as independently observed. No visible Body-localization blocker or automatic mask flag appears in these samples, and no invalid frames were reported. Camera status is consistent across 13 source frames: focal median 806.190 px, relative p10-p90 spread 1.03%, maximum relative deviation 0.69%, no blockers. Temporal consistency does not establish absolute calibration, distortion or principal-point accuracy.
sampling_limitation: Visual inspection covers the listed original/overlay sample frames and every generated QA image, not every source frame. Full mask coverage and hashes were verified automatically. Fine boundary accuracy and later Body reconstruction quality remain unverified.
